newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Gold expected to hold to recent ranges.
newsitem.headline: Gold expected to hold to recent ranges.

text.p: Gold was lower in early Europe but within its recent range and expected to remain around current levels for now, traders said on Wednesday.
Gold was quoted at $340.60/$341.10 an ounce versus $341.40/$341.90 at the London close on Tuesday. It was also slightly lower than the New York close of $341.10/$341.60.
"Gold is still in a range, although in the lower end of it. I think it will stay in the range if no news emerges. The market's main focus is platinum and palladium," a trader said.
He added that those metals were also trading quietly.
Platinum was lower at $375.00/$376.00 versus $377.50/$378.80 but palladium was higher at $155.25/$156.25 versus $154.25/$155.25. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
